annotations.description: Over the last 10m, the success ratio derived from rpc_requests_total (success / total) for provider {{ $labels.provider }} in region {{ $labels.region }} has fallen below 0.95. The provider is returning errors on a meaningful share of read requests.
annotations.runbook: Break down rpc_requests_total by error_kind and method for this provider/region to identify whether failures are timeouts, transport errors, or RPC-level errors.

model.expr: sum by (provider, region) (rate(rpc_requests_total{status="success"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (provider, region) (rate(rpc_requests_total[10m])), 1e-9)
